skill.name: lark-note
skill.description: Use known Lark note IDs to inspect meeting note details, document tokens, display type, and unified transcript routing through lark-cli.
skill.summary: Retrieve Lark meeting note details and unified transcripts when a note_id or vc-node-id is already known.
skill.author: larksuite

content.value_statement: Lark meeting note data can be hard to route when tokens and display types differ. This skill guides note detail lookup and transcript routing from a known note_id.
actual_capabilities: Looks up Lark meeting note details when a note_id is already known.
Identifies note_display_type values for normal, unknown, and unified notes.
Routes note_doc_token and verbatim_doc_token retrieval to the correct document workflow.
Retrieves unified transcript content through the note transcript workflow.
Explains when meeting_id, minute_token, event_id, or title search belong to another Lark skill.
limitations: Requires a known note_id or an explicit vc-node-id from fetched document content.
Does not search meeting note titles or infer note IDs from document text.
Does not read Docx body content directly; it routes that work to the document workflow.
Requires lark-cli access and the user permissions needed to read the note.

use_cases.title: Find note document tokens
use_cases.description: Retrieve note_doc_token, verbatim_doc_token, and shared document tokens for a known meeting note.

use_cases.title: Route transcript access
use_cases.description: Decide whether to read an independent transcript document or use the unified transcript endpoint.

use_cases.title: Trace meeting artifacts
use_cases.description: Move from known meeting or minute identifiers to the correct note workflow without mixing token types.

prompt_templates.title: Check note details
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner lookup with a known note ID.
prompt_templates.prompt: I have note_id NOTE_ID. Use lark-note to show the note display type and available document tokens.

prompt_templates.title: Choose transcript route
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate routing after note detail is available.
prompt_templates.prompt: Given this note detail result, decide whether the transcript should use a document token or unified transcript retrieval.

prompt_templates.title: Use a document marker
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced lookup from a fetched document that contains vc-node-id.
prompt_templates.prompt: This fetched document contains a vc-node-id. Treat it as the note_id and retrieve the related note details.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a mixed request
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced routing across meeting, minute, calendar, and note domains.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these identifiers and route each one to the correct Lark skill before using lark-note for the final note lookup.

output_examples.input: A user provides a note_id and asks for the meeting note document.
output_examples.output: The response reports the note display type and points the user to the note document token for content retrieval.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a transcript after note detail shows unified display type.
output_examples.output: The response uses the unified transcript workflow and does not treat the verbatim document token as the transcript source.

output_examples.input: A user only has a meeting title and wants speaker-by-speaker transcript text.
output_examples.output: The response routes the user to document search first and waits for an explicit vc-node-id before using lark-note.

best_practices: Start with an explicit note_id or vc-node-id before using the note workflow.
Check note_display_type before selecting a transcript source.
Use related Lark skills for meeting, minute, calendar, or document search inputs.
anti_patterns: Do not infer note_id values from document titles, backlinks, or body text.
Do not treat minute_token, meeting_id, or event_id as a note_id.
Do not use verbatim_doc_token for unified transcript routing.

faq.question: What input does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs a known note_id or a vc-node-id found in fetched document content.

faq.question: Can it find notes by title?
faq.answer: No. Use document search first, then return when a vc-node-id is available.

faq.question: Can it read the note document body?
faq.answer: It can identify the note document token, but document body reading belongs to the Lark document workflow.

faq.question: How does it handle unified notes?
faq.answer: It uses the note transcript workflow when note_display_type is unified.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks the skill as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What permissions are required?
faq.answer: The user must have lark-cli access and permission to read the requested Lark meeting note.
